operations.permanent_errors: Enrollment rejected — verify bundle matches edge-plane ID. mTLS handshake failure — check certificates.

operations.concurrent_request_behavior: Not applicable — rotation is lifecycle-owner driven
operations.retry_owner: system (HMACKeyRotationController for HMAC; cert-manager for TLS; JWKS service for JWK)
operations.retryable_errors: cert-manager auto-retries renewal; HMAC rotation has 90-day grace period
operations.permanent_errors: Not documented for each lifecycle owner
operations.evidence_behavior: ZenLock provides custody/distribution/audit for secret material; rotation not performed by ZenLock

operations.repeated_request_result: Idempotent within deduplication window. Same key within window is recognized as duplicate.
operations.retryable_errors: Transient: network timeout, connection refused, rate limit. Undetermined: timeout without response.
operations.permanent_errors: Invalid destination, authentication failure, provider verification failure
operations.evidence_behavior: Returns event_id and delivery_attempts. Every delivery attempt recorded with outcome, timestamps, cryptographic integrity proofs.

operations.operation: replay events from DLQ or delivery history
operations.repeated_request_result: Replay is idempotent — same replay request returns same result. However, replaying the same event range may produce duplicates.
operations.retryable_errors: N/A (initiation is an API call — standard API retry errors apply)
operations.permanent_errors: Retained payload unavailable (retention exceeded), insufficient scope, delivery not found
operations.evidence_behavior: Returns replay_receipt and replayed_event_ids. Each replay attempt recorded with new delivery attempt ID.

operations.operation: delivery retry (manual retry of failed delivery)
operations.repeated_request_result: Retry is idempotent — calling retry on an already-retried delivery does not create duplicate deliveries
operations.retryable_errors: Standard API retry errors: network timeout, rate limit
operations.permanent_errors: 4xx (except 429): insufficient scope, event not found, idempotency conflict
operations.evidence_behavior: Returns retry_receipt with delivery_id and status. Retry re-uses original delivery — does not re-ingest from source.

operations.permanent_errors: Not documented — certificate expiry behavior is UNRESOLVED
operations.evidence_behavior: Certificate bundle evidence via ZenLock audit trail

operations.evidence_behavior: Reapply generates new evidence; divergence detection not automated

generation_method: hand-maintained JSON aligned with idempotency-retry matrix, FAQ, and API documentation
implementation_status_semantics: IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED: retried and confirmed. IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED: code exists, formal verification pending. MANUAL_IN_V1_1: operator-driven procedure available, no automation. PLANNED_V1_1: design complete, not yet implemented.
verification_status_semantics: WIRED_SANDBOX: verified in sandbox. REQUIRES_DOCUMENTATION: procedure documented but automated verification pending. NOT_SUPPORTED: not applicable or not implemented.
